name: Chicken Karaage
assumptions: Recipe serves 4 based on 450g chicken (standard ~110g per serving for Japanese karaage)
Total time includes minimum 1 hour marination + ~15 min active prep and frying in batches
Soy sauce introduces wheat unless certified gluten-free (hence null for Gluten-free)
Sake and potato starch introduce no common allergens
Vegetable oil and lemon introduce none
No dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, or peanuts listed
Fish allergen null due to potential dashi in some soy sauces but not specified here
Shellfish and sesame null as unspecified/ambiguous in source
instructions:
Add the ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sake and sugar to a bowl and whisk to combine. Add the chicken, then stir to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

Add 1 inch of vegetable oil to a heavy bottomed pot and heat until the oil reaches 360 degrees F. Line a wire rack with 2 sheets of paper towels and get your tongs out. Put the potato starch in a bowl

Add a handful of chicken to the potato starch and toss to coat each piece evenly.

Fry the karaage in batches until the exterior is a medium brown and the chicken is cooked through. Transfer the fried chicken to the paper towel lined rack. If you want the karaage to stay crispy longer, you can fry the chicken a second time, until it's a darker color after it's cooled off once. Serve with lemon wedges.

ingredients.name: Chicken
ingredients.assumptions: Boneless chicken thighs with skin, raw weight as specified; typical values for skin-on dark meat chicken.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: Grated fresh ginger root; 1 tablespoon ≈ 6 g.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.assumptions: Minced fresh garlic clove; 1 average clove ≈ 3 g.

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.assumptions: Regular Japanese or all-purpose soy sauce; 2 tablespoons ≈ 30 g.

ingredients.name: Sake
ingredients.assumptions: Japanese cooking sake (rice wine); 1 tablespoon ≈ 15 g.

ingredients.name: Potato starch
ingredients.assumptions: Potato starch (katakuriko); 1/3 cup ≈ 45 g, used as coating (not all may adhere but full amount estimated).

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.assumptions: Neutral vegetable oil for deep frying; 1/3 cup added to pot but only a fraction absorbed (≈10-15% uptake assumed for total recipe estimate, using full listed quantity for conservative total).

ingredients.name: Lemon
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh lemon wedges for serving; 1/3 cup juice + peel equivalent ≈ 50 g total edible portion.
